statement: Invoice 88412 lists USD 148,300 as unpaid and due, but its payment history records full payment on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, so I’m holding it to prevent a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer names the internal contradiction as disqualifying — "lists USD 148,300 as unpaid and due, but its payment history records full payment on 3 September... so I'm holding it to prevent a duplicate payment."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
